about_the_game:
Additional 10 levels of Anomalous Winter Battle Pass will help you unlock many rewards:
  • Unique submachine gun SIG MPX;
  • Exclusive Ice Pick;
  • Themed camouflage for weapons and armor;
  • Tools and components to improve your gear;
  • Additional Premium days and more.

Note!
  • This pack can only be purchased ONCE per character;
  • All rewards are personal;
  • All rewards will be activated automatically upon receipt. If this has not happened, rewards can be found on your Personal Warehouse;
  • These rewards are not cross-platform and can only be used on Steam;
  • These rewards can only be granted to the same Steam account that was used to made the purchase. If you have some issues, contact our EXBO Support;
  • EXBO may update, replace, or remove in-game content at any time.
